architecture.summary: PR 1 of the habit-hooks cleanup stack removes comments that the code does not need, in two passes (a first pass and a stricter pass), in src/, test/, and script/. It changes no code: for each of the 307 changed TypeScript files, the print without comments is the same at the merge base and at HEAD. Comments that main rewrote after the classification stay. No component, dependency edge, public module, declaration, contract, external dependency, composition, build output, or deployment relationship changes. The declaration snapshots have no comments (removeComments in tsconfig.api-surface.json), so the 16 touched public modules keep identical declarations. No flag applies: the change removes comments only and changes no behavior of the product or of the policy tools. The protected policy paths (script/pr-review/**) and twelve security guarantee files select T1 Team review. The component registry describes the runtime system only; its prose and all 21 views remain accurate and unchanged.
